title: Identifying Customer Needs from User-Generated Content
eligible_reason: Machine-learning (CNN, embeddings, clustering) identification of customer needs from Amazon review sentences compared with interview-based needs. No treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: Preprocessing.py builds embeddings; Table 2.py, Figure 5 A2.py, Figure 6.py, Figure 7 A3 A4.py reproduce classification and coverage results.
data_files_note: Review sentences, labeled sentences, needs hierarchy and survey ratings.
data_provenance_note: Data as used in the paper; no masking stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
